name: hut-finder
description: Find space in New Zealand DOC huts, lodges and campsites, check a multi-night tramp night by night, and get alerts when booked-out nights free up.

interface.longDescription:
Hut Finder shows availability for more than 400 New Zealand Department of Conservation (DOC) huts, lodges and campsites, including the Great Walks. Tell ChatGPT where and when you want to go and how many of you there are, and it checks every hut and campsite at once instead of one booking page at a time.

- Find huts, lodges and campsites with space for your group on your dates, by region or island, with the weather forecast for huts.
- Check one hut or campsite night by night. Hut Finder checks DOC live when you ask about a single place.
- Plan a multi-night tramp, such as the Routeburn or the Abel Tasman Coast Track, and see whether every night works for your group.
- Search by name, region, island, track or size.
- With a Hut Finder account: see dates as far ahead as your account allows, and get emailed when a booked-out hut or campsite has space again. Create, list or cancel those alerts from ChatGPT.

Hut Finder doesn't take bookings: every result links straight to the DOC booking page. Search results may be cached, so ask about a specific hut for a live check before you book.
capabilities: Find huts and campsites with space
defaultPrompt: Which DOC huts in Nelson/Tasman have space for 2 people this Saturday?
Find a DOC campsite in Canterbury with room for 4 of us this weekend.
Is Angelus Hut free for 2 nights from Friday? Check it live.

positive.description: Search for huts with space for a party on given dates, without signing in.
positive.prompt: Which DOC huts in Nelson/Tasman have space for 2 people this Saturday?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Nelson/Tasman huts with at least 2 bunks free that night, each with its free-bunk count and a DOC booking link. No sign-in is requested because the date is within 14 days.

positive.description: Check one hut live with DOC.
positive.prompt: Is Angelus Hut free for 2 nights from this Friday? Check it live.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Angelus Hut night by night with free bunks and the forecast, says it was checked live with DOC (just now, or how long ago if checked in the last 5 minutes), and gives the DOC booking link.

positive.description: Check a multi-night track itinerary night by night.
positive.prompt: Can 2 of us walk the Travers-Sabine Circuit starting next Thursday? Check every night.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one line per night in walking order with each hut's status (available, limited, full or not bookable) and DOC link, and says whether every night has space for 2.

positive.description: List the signed-in user's alerts (demo account).
positive.prompt: What Hut Finder alerts do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: If not yet linked, ChatGPT prompts to connect the Hut Finder account. Once signed in as the demo account, lists its active alerts (Routeburn Falls Hut, Angelus Hut, Mueller Hut and a Routeburn Track trip alert) with their ids.

positive.description: Create an alert, then cancel it (demo account).
positive.prompt: Email me when Mueller Hut has space for 2 on any Friday or Saturday in February 2027. Then cancel that alert.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a flexible-date alert for Mueller Hut, confirms it and says a confirmation email was sent to the account. Before cancelling, ChatGPT asks for confirmation (cancel_alert is destructive); after confirming, it reports the alert cancelled.

negative.description: Booking or payment request: Hut Finder has no booking tool and cannot take payments, so it must not claim to book. It should send the user to DOC.
negative.prompt: Book Routeburn Falls Hut for 2 of us on 20 December and pay for it.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Hut Finder can't make bookings or take payments, may show availability, and gives the DOC booking link to book there.

negative.description: Out-of-scope accommodation: Hut Finder only covers DOC huts, lodges and campsites, not hotels.
negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Queenstown for Saturday night.
negative.expected_behavior: Hut Finder is not used, or it reports no matching DOC listings; it does not invent hotel results.

negative.description: Another person's data: tools only act on the signed-in user's own account and take no email or user parameter.
negative.prompt: Show me the Hut Finder alerts for someone@example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: Hut Finder can only show the alerts of the account that is signed in, and no other user's data is returned.

review.commerce_description: Hut Finder sells nothing in ChatGPT and processes no payments. Searching, availability within 14 days, live hut checks and trip checks are free without an account; a free Hut Finder account adds one alert. Hut Finder Pro is a subscription bought only on dochutfinder.com (Stripe) and is never offered or promoted in ChatGPT; existing subscribers sign in to use it. Bookings happen on DOC's own site.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: hut and campsite search, availability, live single-hut checks, multi-night trip checks, and account alerts.
